workstreams.native_signing: Avantiqo portal simple electronic signature bound to exact controlled document version/checksum

workstreams.name: Auditor package
workstreams.generation_gate: CLOSED/LOCKED accounting period + COMPLETED governed close run + CURRENT close fingerprint + balanced trial balance
workstreams.package: immutable restricted controlled ZIP with reports, GL, journals, reconciliations, tax/statutory, close adjustments, review/approval and supporting evidence
workstreams.current_business_blocker: Selected live periods remain open and no governed close run exists yet.

workstreams.name: Finance provider activation
workstreams.vault_boundary: Supabase Vault service-role-only Finance provider provisioner
workstreams.bank_activation: Brankas API credential -> Vault -> pending transaction-feed connections rebound -> customer consent
workstreams.etax_activation: Certified provider credential -> Vault -> exact Thailand customer-invoice e-Tax profile
workstreams.email_activation: Existing Administration Google/Microsoft/IMAP-SMTP connector linked directly from Finance Client access
workstreams.secret_exposure: No raw provider secret returned through Finance API or stored in Finance metadata
workstreams.current_business_blocker: Real Brankas/e-Tax/mailbox provider credentials still need to be supplied by the organization/provider.

workstreams.name: Provider connection verification
workstreams.bank_verification: Read-only Brankas GET /v1/statements validates credential without consent, import or reconciliation.
workstreams.etax_verification: Read-only provider health endpoint or auth handshake; otherwise remains configured-unverified instead of fabricating verification.
workstreams.verification_receipt: Provider metadata/profile records verification status, attempt time, successful verification time and bounded error detail.

workstreams.name: Centralized connection health and durable verification evidence
workstreams.settings_overview: Finance Settings shows bank feeds, Thailand e-Tax and client email with exact current readiness and next action.
workstreams.verification_history: Every real provider verification attempt is append-only evidence with provider, status, verification mode, timestamp and bounded error/detail.
workstreams.latest_state: Provider credential metadata and durable verification event are updated atomically through one service-role RPC.
workstreams.secret_protection: Verification detail rejects secret fields and secret references.

workstreams.name: Finance scale integrity closure
workstreams.legal_entity_uniqueness: Exact organization-scoped indexed conflict lookups replace the bounded 1000-row scan; database normalized unique indexes remain the race-safe backstop.
workstreams.correction_duplicate_preflight: Exact JSON correction identity is filtered before limit; database active-correction unique index remains authoritative.
workstreams.correction_account_selector: Complete paginated chart-of-accounts population replaces the prior 1000-row cap.

workstreams.name: Client portal population integrity
workstreams.work_status: Engagement runs and work items use complete paginated populations rather than 200/5000 row caps.
workstreams.open_requests: Open client requests and evidence use complete batched populations rather than 200/1000 row caps.
workstreams.tax_filings: Client-visible filing truth uses complete Finance populations rather than a 100-row cap.
workstreams.messages: Display remains intentionally bounded, but exact total/has-more are exposed and all unread firm messages are marked read across the full engagement scope.

workstreams.name: Decision population integrity
workstreams.account_health: Bank accounts and reconciliation evidence use complete populations instead of a 500-row cap.
workstreams.exchange_rate_resolution: Requested direct/inverse currency pair is filtered first and read to completeness; unrelated recent rates cannot crowd it out.
workstreams.intercompany_rate_resolution: Intercompany FX uses the same exact pair evidence rather than newest-250 scanning.
workstreams.number_sequence_scope_lock: Allocated document-type aliases are queried exactly; configuration cannot become changeable because allocation falls beyond row 250.
workstreams.fx_revaluation_inputs: Chart of accounts and active exchange-rate inputs are complete; only historical run display remains intentionally bounded.

workstreams.name: Accounting-firm multi-client scale integrity
workstreams.practice_control: Complete active engagements, client profiles, reviews, runs, work items, review notes and client requests with no fixed 500/5000/10000 truth caps.
workstreams.client_access: Complete engagement/grant populations; conversations and delivery receipts are complete for active portals; unread client messages are marked read across the full firm/engagement scope.
workstreams.onboarding: Every firm engagement, contract link, controlled engagement document, signature and billing profile participates in readiness.
workstreams.time_and_wip: Complete firm-scoped engagement, work, billing configuration and time-entry populations drive WIP and invoice readiness.
workstreams.client_route_default: Dedicated Clients route defaults to ALL instead of hiding clear clients behind an ATTENTION filter.

workstreams.name: Accounting-practice decision scale integrity
workstreams.capacity: 90-day committed-work forecast reads the complete open-work population instead of stopping at 10000 items.
workstreams.billing: Practice invoice amount and idempotency bind the complete approved billable-time population; no entry can fall outside a 10000-row window.
workstreams.work_programs: Runs, work items and client requests are complete populations instead of a 500-run slice.
workstreams.engagement_file: Runs, reviews, documents, work items, client requests, review notes, signoffs, staff capacity and evidence links are complete before review/progress summaries are derived.
